comparisons.peer_topic: Real Estate Exposure and Criticized Assets Changes
comparisons.peer_summary: Real Estate exposure was $207.1 billion as of December 31, 2024. Criticized exposure increased by $3.2 billion to $12.4 billion, driven by downgrades primarily in Multifamily and Office.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and JPM disclose that criticized exposure increased in 2024 driven by broad-based industry weaknesses and downgrades. BAC attributes a $1.4 billion (12%) increase to a broad range of industries, while JPM reports a $3.2 billion increase in criticized exposure within its Real Estate segment, specifically noting that it was predominantly driven by downgrades in Multifamily and Office sectors. Both filings identify downgrades and broad portfolio segments as key drivers of increased criticized assets.
